cues.en: Let's now create our Docker file.
cues.zh: 現在來建立 Dockerfile。

cues.en: We're going to be using something called multi-stage builds, both in development and in production to produce optimized Docker images.
cues.zh: 開發與正式環境都會使用多階段建置，產生最佳化的 Docker 映像檔。

cues.en: This optimization will help produce the final image size by not including the build dependencies in the final image.
cues.zh: 最終映像檔不包含建置時的相依套件，因此能縮小映像檔大小。

cues.en: If you read more on multi-stage builds, here is the documentation.
cues.zh: 若想進一步了解多階段建置，可以看這份文件。

cues.en: Let's start building our Docker file step by step so you can go back to your IDE.
cues.zh: 一步一步建立 Dockerfile，回到 IDE。

cues.en: And then we're going to go to backend, then Docker.
cues.zh: 前往 backend，再進 docker。

cues.en: Then within Docker we go to local, then first API, then open that particular Docker file.
cues.zh: 進入 local/fastapi，開啟這個 Dockerfile。

cues.en: We're going to start our Docker file by defining the Python version to be used as an argument.
cues.zh: 先用建置參數定義要使用的 Python 版本。

cues.en: So you can say arg like that.
cues.zh: 輸入 ARG。

cues.en: Then you can say our Python version that's going to be three point 13.1 like that.
cues.zh: 設定 PYTHON_VERSION=3.13.1。

cues.en: Then we're going to define an alias for the Python image to be used as the base image.
cues.zh: 接著為 Python 映像檔定義別名，作為基底映像檔。

cues.en: As you can see from then we're going to say Python.
cues.zh: 使用 FROM，後面是 python。

cues.en: Then we're going to pass in our Python version argument by dollar sign curly braces.
cues.zh: 再用 ${} 傳入 Python 版本參數。

cues.en: And you can say Python version like that, then hyphen slim then hyphen bookworm, then as Python like that.
cues.zh: 也就是 PYTHON_VERSION，接上 -slim-bookworm，再加 AS python。

cues.en: And so basically this slim is a lightweight version of the Python image that you're going to be using.
cues.zh: slim 是較輕量的 Python 映像檔版本。

cues.en: Then bookworm is the codename for the Debian 12 operating system.
cues.zh: bookworm 則是 Debian 12 作業系統的代號。

cues.en: Then by using this directive as we're basically defining an alias for the Python image to be used as our base image.
cues.zh: 透過 AS，為這個 Python 基底映像檔定義別名。

cues.en: Then, since we're using multi-stage builds, we're going to start with the first stage.
cues.zh: 因為使用多階段建置，先從第一階段開始。

cues.en: And the first stage is going to be to build our dependency wheels.
cues.zh: 第一階段會建置相依套件的 wheel 檔。

cues.en: So I can add a comment and say stage one.
cues.zh: 加入註解，寫 Stage 1。

cues.en: This one is going to be build dependency wheels like that.
cues.zh: 這個階段叫 Build dependency wheels。

cues.en: And basically Python wheels are a precompiled binary package for Python modules.
cues.zh: Python wheel 基本上是 Python 模組預先編譯的二進位套件。

cues.en: They are used to install dependencies in a faster and more efficient way.
cues.zh: 可更快速、有效率地安裝相依套件。

cues.en: As you can see from now.
cues.zh: 接著寫 FROM，

cues.en: Python.
cues.zh: 再加 python。

cues.en: Remember, Python is the alias that we just created up above for these Python version that we're using.
cues.zh: 記得，python 是剛才為所用 Python 版本建立的別名。

cues.en: As you can see from Python, then we're going to give our build stage an alias as you can see as then you can call this Python build stage.
cues.zh: FROM python，再用 AS 為這個建置階段命名，可以叫 python-build-stage。

cues.en: Remember you can call this whatever you want but let it make sense.
cues.zh: 名稱可以自行決定，但要有意義。

cues.en: And so in our case, since we're in the first stage where we're building the The dependencies.
cues.zh: 因為第一階段要建置

cues.en: It's correct to give this first stage the alias of the Python build stage.
cues.zh: 相依套件，叫 python-build-stage 很合理。

cues.en: Then we're going to use the run command to execute a command in the container.
cues.zh: 接著使用 RUN，在容器內執行命令。

cues.en: As you can see run.
cues.zh: 輸入 RUN，

cues.en: Then we're going to see apt get update and then and APT get install.
cues.zh: 再接 apt-get update && apt-get install。

cues.en: Then you're going to have a backslash like that so that you can have the command run in multiple lines.
cues.zh: 加上反斜線，讓命令可分成多行。

cues.en: Before we can proceed let me explain what you're doing here.
cues.zh: 繼續之前，解釋一下這裡的作用。

cues.en: So in this first run command we're executing this command to build the container.
cues.zh: 這個 RUN 會在建置容器時執行這段命令。

cues.en: And first we're using the apt which is the package manager for the Debian or Ubuntu systems.
cues.zh: 先使用 APT，它是 Debian 或 Ubuntu 系統的套件管理工具。

cues.en: And when you say apt get update, we're basically updating the package index using APT as the package manager to get the latest information about available packages, then APT get install.
cues.zh: apt-get update 會更新套件索引，透過 APT 取得目前可用套件的最新資訊；接著 apt-get install，

cues.en: We're basically using this to install the packages on the container.
cues.zh: 用來在容器裡安裝套件。

cues.en: Then in the next line just stab it in.
cues.zh: 下一行先縮排。

cues.en: We can now say dash dash, no, then install, then hyphen recommends like that, then dash y.
cues.zh: 加入 --no-install-recommends，再接 -y。

cues.en: Then we can have a backslash to enter a new line.
cues.zh: 再加反斜線換行。

cues.en: So before you proceed let me explain.
cues.zh: 先解釋一下。

cues.en: By default APT will install required dependencies which are a must have, and recommended packages which are nice to have but are optional, and suggested packages which are not required but recommended.
cues.zh: 依講者說明，APT 預設會安裝必要相依套件，以及非必要但建議安裝的 recommended 套件，還有 suggested 套件。

cues.en: So when we say no install recommends this flag is going to tell apt to only install the required dependencies.
cues.zh: --no-install-recommends 告訴 APT，只安裝必要相依套件。

cues.en: Then the flag is going to automatically answer yes to any prompts for confirmation, allowing the installation to proceed without manual intervention.
cues.zh: -y 則自動對確認提示回答 yes，讓安裝無須人工介入就能繼續。

cues.en: Then in the next line we can say build essential.
cues.zh: 下一行加入 build-essential。

cues.en: Then backslash again.
cues.zh: 再加反斜線。

cues.en: So build essential is a meta package in Debian or Ubuntu systems that installs everything needed to compile the software.
cues.zh: build-essential 是 Debian 或 Ubuntu 的中繼套件，安裝編譯軟體所需的所有工具。

cues.en: And in our case, we need the build essential in our Dockerfile, because some Python packages in our requirements like psycopg, async pkg and potentially others are not pure Python packages.
cues.zh: 這份 Dockerfile 需要它，因為 requirements 裡的 Psycopg、asyncpg 等套件，不全是純 Python。

cues.en: They contain some C extensions that need to be compiled during installation.
cues.zh: 它們包含一些 C 擴充，需要在安裝時編譯。

cues.en: Then in the next line we can say lib pq, then hyphen dev like that and lib pq dev.
cues.zh: 下一行加入 libpq-dev。

cues.en: This is the development package that includes all necessary files for building Python packages that need to interact with Postgres like psycopg and async pkg, which are in our requirements.txt file.
cues.zh: 這是開發套件，包含建置需要與 Postgres 互動的 Python 套件所需檔案，例如 requirements.txt 裡的 Psycopg 與 asyncpg。

cues.en: So that is it for the run command.
cues.zh: RUN 命令就到這裡。

cues.en: Then we're going to have a copy command.
cues.zh: 接著使用 COPY，

cues.en: And we're going to use this to copy files or directories from the host machine to the container.
cues.zh: 從主機將檔案或目錄複製到容器。

cues.en: So we can say here copy.
cues.zh: 輸入 COPY。

cues.en: Then we're going to copy the requirements.txt from the host machine to the container.
cues.zh: 我們要將主機上的 requirements.txt 複製到容器。

cues.en: So our requirements.txt file is in backend.
cues.zh: requirements.txt 位於 backend，

cues.en: Then slash requirements dot txt.
cues.zh: 裡面的 requirements.txt。

cues.en: We can always confirm that if you go to backend we have requirements dot txt right there.
cues.zh: 到 backend 就能確認，檔案在這裡。

cues.en: And we want to copy this requirements.txt to the container.
cues.zh: 要將 requirements.txt 複製到容器。

cues.en: And we can symbolize the location of the container with the dot like that.
cues.zh: 目的位置用 . 表示。

cues.en: Then we're going to create Python dependency and dependency wheels by using the run command.
cues.zh: 接著透過 RUN，建置 Python 相依套件與其相依套件的 wheel。

cues.en: As you can see run pip.
cues.zh: 輸入 RUN pip，

cues.en: Then we'll then double hyphen specify the wheel directory.
cues.zh: 再接 wheel，並用雙連字號指定 wheel 目錄。

cues.en: So we'll hyphen directory.
cues.zh: 也就是 --wheel-dir。

cues.en: In our case it's going to be slash user then slash src then slash app then wheels like that, then backslash to enter a new line.
cues.zh: 目錄設為 /usr/src/app/wheels，再加反斜線換行。

cues.en: Then you can say dash r requirements dot txt then backslash again.
cues.zh: 接著 -r requirements.txt，再加反斜線。

cues.en: Then we can say dash dash no cash.
cues.zh: 再寫 --no-cache，

cues.en: So no hyphen cash, then hyphen directory like that.
cues.zh: 後面接 -dir，也就是 --no-cache-dir。

cues.en: Let me explain what you're doing here.
cues.zh: 解釋一下。

cues.en: So in this stage here we're creating the dependency and dependency wheels.
cues.zh: 這個階段會建立相依套件與次級相依套件的 wheel。

cues.en: And basically remember the wheels are a prebuilt package format that install faster and are more efficient than source distributions.
cues.zh: 記得，wheel 是預先建置的套件格式，安裝更快，也比原始碼散布套件更有效率。

cues.en: And they don't require compilation during installation.
cues.zh: 安裝時不需要再編譯。

cues.en: Then at this point here we're specifying the wheel directory, which in our case is going to be user src app wheels.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 wheel 目錄，設為 /usr/src/app/wheels。

cues.en: And this is where the generated wheel files are going to be saved.
cues.zh: 產生的 wheel 檔會儲存在這裡。

cues.en: Then on this line we're using Dash R option which reads the requirements.txt file and installs the dependencies.
cues.zh: 這一行使用 -r，讀取 requirements.txt，處理所列的相依套件。

cues.en: Then when we say dash dash no cash directory here we are preventing people from using its cache directory.
cues.zh: --no-cache-dir 則防止 pip 使用快取目錄。

cues.en: And this is going to help us in reducing the Docker image size.
cues.zh: 這有助於縮小 Docker 映像檔。

cues.en: So that's it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture we're still going to be continuing with this Docker file because it involves a lot.
cues.zh: 下一堂課會繼續編寫 Dockerfile，因為內容很多。
